rules.source: Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados Pessoais (LGPD), Lei No. 13.709/2018 — http://www.planalto.gov.br/ccivil_03/_ato2015-2018/2018/lei/L13709.htm
rules.retrieved_snippet: LGPD establishes norms for the protection and processing of personal data in Brazilian national territory, protecting fundamental rights of freedom, privacy, honor and intimacy.

rules.source: Estatuto Digital da Criança e do Adolescente (ECA Digital), Lei No. 15.211/2025 — https://infograficos.camara.leg.br/eca-digital/
rules.retrieved_snippet: First Brazilian law with specific rules/punishments for digital platforms regarding children and adolescents. Any product/service likely to be accessed by minors must guarantee priority protection, best-interest-of-the-child as parameter, and high privacy/data-protection/security levels. Became enforceable 2026-03-17.

rules.source: Estatuto Digital da Criança e do Adolescente (ECA Digital), Lei No. 15.211/2025 — https://infograficos.camara.leg.br/eca-digital/
rules.retrieved_snippet: Platforms must adopt effective age-verification methods (not simple self-declaration) and have clear rules preventing sexual exploitation, cyberbullying, harmful-practice inducement, gambling promotion, and predatory advertising toward minors.

rules.source: Código de Defesa do Consumidor, Lei No. 8.078/1990 — https://www.consumidor.gov.br/pages/conteudo/publico/102
rules.retrieved_snippet: Establishes norms of protection and defense of the consumer, of public order and social interest.

rules.source: No enacted comprehensive AI statute as of September 2026 — PL 2338/2023 (Marco Legal da Inteligência Artificial) was approved unanimously by the Federal Senate on 10 December 2024 and sent to the Chamber of Deputies in March 2025, where it remains pending in the Special Commission awaiting the rapporteur's opinion and a floor vote expected in 2026. Not yet law — https://www25.senado.leg.br/web/atividade/materias/-/materia/157233
rules.retrieved_snippet: PL 2338/2023 establishes a risk-based regulatory framework (prohibited/high-risk/limited-or-moderate risk, modeled on the EU AI Act) with transparency, explanation, and contestation rights — approved by the Senate, pending Chamber of Deputies vote as of this research.

rules.source: Lei Brasileira de Inclusão da Pessoa com Deficiência (LBI / Estatuto da Pessoa com Deficiência), Lei No. 13.146/2015, Article 63 — https://www.planalto.gov.br/ccivil_03/_ato2015-2018/2015/lei/l13146.htm
rules.retrieved_snippet: Article 63 makes digital accessibility mandatory for websites maintained by government bodies and by companies with headquarters or commercial presence in Brazil. A new technical standard, ABNT NBR 17225, was launched to operationalize Article 63's requirements for websites and web applications.

rules.source: Resolução CD/ANPD nº 15, de 24 de abril de 2024 (Regulamento de Comunicação de Incidente de Segurança) — https://www.gov.br/anpd/pt-br/assuntos/noticias/anpd-aprova-o-regulamento-de-comunicacao-de-incidente-de-seguranca
rules.retrieved_snippet: The controller must notify the ANPD and affected data subjects of a security incident that may cause relevant risk or damage; the deadline to notify the ANPD is three business days from when the controller learns the incident affected personal data. Risk is presumed where sensitive data, data of children, adolescents or elderly people, financial or authentication data, or large-scale data is involved.

rules.source: Lei No. 12.737/2012 (created Código Penal art. 154-A, invasão de dispositivo informático), as amended by Lei No. 14.155/2021 — https://www.planalto.gov.br/ccivil_03/_ato2011-2014/2012/lei/l12737.htm
rules.retrieved_snippet: Art. 154-A of the Penal Code punishes invading another's computing device, connected or not to a network, by unlawfully breaching a security mechanism to obtain, alter or destroy data or install vulnerabilities; Lei 14.155/2021 raised the penalty to reclusão of 1 to 4 years plus a fine (per Planalto's consolidated text as summarized by the search; check the current wording on planalto.gov.br).

rules.source: Marco Civil da Internet, Lei No. 12.965/2014 (regulated by Decreto 8.771/2016; Decreto 12.975/2026 amends the regulation) — https://www.planalto.gov.br/ccivil_03/_ato2011-2014/2014/lei/l12965.htm
rules.retrieved_snippet: Establishes principles, guarantees, rights and duties for internet use in Brazil (Art. 1); principles include freedom of expression, privacy, personal data protection and net neutrality (Art. 3); connection logs must be kept for one year (Art. 13); Art. 19 requires a specific court order before an application provider is liable for third-party content, and a 2026 decree updating the regulation is listed on Planalto.

Regulates the constitutional provision on terrorism (art. 5, XLIII), defines the offense and its procedure; terrorism is committed by acts motivated by xenophobia, discrimination or prejudice with the aim of provoking social or generalized terror (art. 2); offenses are treated as against the interest of the Union, investigated by the Federal Police (art. 11).

Regulates copyright and related rights; Article 46 lists uses that are not infringement, such as reproduction of news in the press with the author's name and source cited; Lei 12.853/2013 added rules on collective management and Decreto 9.574/2018 regulates collective management.

rules.source: Lei No. 9.613/1998 (Lei de Lavagem de Dinheiro) — https://www.planalto.gov.br/ccivil_03/leis/l9613compilado.htm
rules.retrieved_snippet: Defines money laundering offenses and created the COAF (financial intelligence council); amended by Lei 12.683/2012 to make prosecution more effective and by Lei 14.478/2022; Lei 13.974/2020 restructured the COAF with technical and operational autonomy, administratively tied to the Banco Central do Brasil.

rules.source: Lei No. 7.716/1989 (crimes resultantes de preconceito de raça ou de cor), as amended by Lei 9.459/1997 and Lei 14.532/2023 — https://www.planalto.gov.br/ccivil_03/leis/l7716.htm
rules.retrieved_snippet: Criminalizes discrimination or prejudice of race, color, ethnicity, religion or national origin (as widened by Lei 9.459/1997); Lei 14.532/2023 added art. 2-A treating racial insult (injúria racial) as racism, with reclusão of 2 to 5 years and a fine.

rules.source: Resolução TSE nº 23.610, de 18 de dezembro de 2019 (propaganda eleitoral), as amended in 2024 and 2026 for artificial intelligence — https://www.tse.jus.br/legislacao/compilada/res/2019/resolucao-no-23-610-de-18-de-dezembro-de-2019
rules.retrieved_snippet: The TSE amended the resolution in February 2024 to ban deepfakes in election propaganda and to require notice of AI use in campaign content; the consolidated text defines a deepfake as synthetic audio or video altering the image or voice of a real, deceased or fictional person and bans use to favor or harm a candidacy (art. 9-C); the AI-labeling duty is in art. 9-B; a candidate using a deepfake can lose registration or mandate (per TSE news pages; the 2026 amendments and thesis are described on tse.jus.br).

Created fixed-odds betting as a lottery modality authorized by the Ministério da Fazenda; bets on youth categories or events with only minor athletes are not allowed; winnings are taxed at 15% income tax per the Receita Federal. STATUS CAVEAT: the Planalto page now marks many articles as revoked by Medida Provisória nº 1.394/2026, which per the Ministry of Finance prohibits operation, offer, intermediation and advertising of fixed-odds lotteries; whether the MP was converted into law was not confirmed in the retrieved sources — verify before relying on it.
